description: This Kotlin class defines the internal state management for a Tic Tac Toe game in an Android application. It handles game logic, state persistence, and updates in response to user interactions, encapsulating the game board, current turn, game over status, and win line information.

classes.name: TicTacToeState
classes.description: Manages the state of a Tic Tac Toe game, including move processing, state saving and restoring, with no AndroidX ViewModel dependencies.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles a cell tap event by applying move rules, updating the game state, and returning the result indicating whether the game continues, is won, drawn, or no operation occurred.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the game to the initial starting state with an empty board and X to move.

methods.name: saveToBundle
methods.description: Serializes the game state into a Bundle for process death or recreation handling.

methods.name: restoreFromBundle
methods.description: Restores the game state from a previously saved Bundle.
